newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 11.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Tuesday:
WASHINGTON - America Online Inc is tapping the talents of former NBC programming wunderkind Brandon Tartikoff to head an Internet site focusing on movies, television, music and other entertainment.
HORI, Japan - Tens of millions of Japanese maintain accounts at the post office, making it the largest financial institution in the country.
WASHINGTON - General Electric Co said it would acquire Greenwich Air Services Inc of Miami, considerably expanding GE's aircraft service business.
NEW YORK - The owner of Spy Factory, a national chain of stores selling personal protection items, and two top executives pleaded guilty to illegally selling wiretapping and bugging devices.
